LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are phrasal verbs formed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text
2. use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text

What this means
In this part you learn to identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences

What this means
In this part you learn to use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs to a partner. (skill: use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text.
3. Practise this skill: use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are phrasal verbs formed?
2. How can one tell the meaning of a phrasal verb?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text.
5. Be able to: use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
